name: project_save
description: Create a project (status draft or running) or update its status. running on a draft starts it; running with reopen on a completed project starts an incremental run. status completed writes graph.json and manifest.json to S3. Returns the user's steering notes while running.

brief.description: Research brief: depth (quick|standard|deep), audience, startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), includeDomains, excludeDomains, notes

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.

name: project_steer
description: Redirect a running project (kind redirect, with text) or ask it to wrap up with what it has (kind finish).

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.

name: project_notify
description: Turn the end-of-run email on or off for a project.

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.

name: project_stop
description: Stop a running project for good: status becomes stopped, later writes are refused, and project.stopped is announced. Idempotent. Returns the runtime session id so the caller can also stop the research runtime.

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.

name: project_list
description: List the caller's projects, newest first.

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.

name: project_get
description: Return a project with its plan, findings, sub-UI specs, entities and edges.

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.

name: project_restart
description: Allocate a new project id that continues an existing project.

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.

name: project_cleanup
description: Archive and clean up a project in the background. A running project must be stopped first.

_caller.description: Set by the gateway from the caller's token. Leave empty.
